records.jp: 伶那さん……ごめん
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, Rena...
records.en: I'm sorry, Rena-san...

records.jp: どうしたの、急に
records.en_original: What's the matter?
records.en_auxiliary: What's the matter?
records.en: Why all of a sudden?

records.jp: ……伶那さんはずっと、詩さんの記憶を<CR>取り戻すべきじゃないって言ってたでしょ？
records.en_original: From the beginning, you said that we shouldn't recover Uta's memories.
records.en_auxiliary: From the beginning, you said that we shouldn't recover Uta's memories.
records.en: ...Rena-san, you've been saying all along that<CR>we shouldn't recover Uta-san's memories, haven't you?

records.jp: 結局、それは正しかった……。<CR>だから、ごめん
records.en_original: You were right all along. I'm sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: You were right all along. I'm sorry.
records.en: In the end, you were right...<CR>So I am sorry.

records.jp: みんなに何か言わなきゃって思ったんだけど……<CR>ごめんって言葉しか出てこなくて
records.en_original: I figured I should talk to everyone...and tell them that I was sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: I figured I should talk to everyone...and tell them that I was sorry.
records.en: I thought I had to say something to everyone...<CR>but "I am sorry" was all I could manage.

records.jp: 私、どうすればよかったのかな……
records.en_original: I don't really know what to do...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't really know what to do...
records.en: What should I have done...?

records.jp: ……なるほどね
records.en_original: ...So that's how it is, is it?
records.en_auxiliary: ...So that's how it is, is it?
records.en: ...I see.

records.jp: 私も、あれからずっと考えてた
records.en_original: I've also been considering our situation.
records.en_auxiliary: I've also been considering our situation.
records.en: I've been thinking about it ever since.

records.jp: あの時の判断は間違っていたのか。<CR>やっぱり、自分の意見を貫き通すべきだったのか
records.en_original: Whether my judgement was sound or not. Was I just pushing my own opinion on everyone?
records.en_auxiliary: Whether my judgement was sound or not. Was I just pushing my own opinion on everyone?
records.en: Was my decision back then wrong?<CR>Should I have held firmly to my own opinion after all?

records.jp: たしかに、自分の意見を押し通していれば<CR>この世界がここまで傷つくことはなかったかもしれない
records.en_original: If I had pushed harder, it's possible that this world would not be in this position.
records.en_auxiliary: If I had pushed harder, it's possible that this world would not be in this position.
records.en: If I had forced my opinion through,<CR>this world might not have been damaged so badly.

records.jp: でも……結局それじゃ一歩も進めなかったんだと思う
records.en_original: But we may not have made any progress either.
records.en_auxiliary: But we may not have made any progress either.
records.en: But... I don't think we'd have made any progress that way.

records.jp: 伶那さん……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...
records.en: Rena-san...

records.jp: いろいろと偉そうなことを言ってるけど……白状する
records.en_original: It's easy to act like I know everything, but truthfully...
records.en_auxiliary: It's easy to act like I know everything, but truthfully...
records.en: I have said all sorts of high-and-mighty things... but I will confess.

records.jp: 怖いのよ……踏み出すことが
records.en_original: I'm scared. Scared to take a step forward.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm scared. Scared to take a step forward.
records.en: I am afraid... afraid to take that step.

records.jp: どうなるかわからないから。<CR>叩ける石橋は、叩きたい
records.en_original: We never know what might be waiting for us. I prefer to be as prepared as possible.
records.en_auxiliary: We never know what might be waiting for us. I prefer to be as prepared as possible.
records.en: We don't know what might happen.<CR>I want to be as prepared as possible.

records.jp: だから駒川さんの記憶を取り戻すの、反対してた
records.en_original: Which is why I was opposed to Komagawa recovering her memories.
records.en_auxiliary: Which is why I was opposed to Komagawa recovering her memories.
records.en: Which is why I was opposed to Komagawa-san recovering her memories.

records.jp: 踏み出すしかないとわかっていても……<CR>いろいろ屁理屈こねて、進めない
records.en_original: Even though I knew it was a step we had to take eventually, I let myself get caught up on the details.
records.en_auxiliary: Even though I knew it was a step we had to take eventually, I let myself get caught up on the details.
records.en: Even when I know I have no choice but to step forward...<CR>I make excuses and cannot move.

records.jp: 私……怖がりだから
records.en_original: I'm...just a coward.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...just a coward.
records.en: I'm...just a coward.

records.jp: でも、私は怖がりでいいと思う
records.en_original: But I don't think that is such a bad thing.
records.en_auxiliary: But I don't think that is such a bad thing.
records.en: But I think it is all right for me to be a coward.

records.jp: ヤバいときは止める。その役割は私がやる。<CR>だから、星崎さんは突き進めばいいんだよ
records.en_original: Because that way, I can be the one to reign you in. You need to be the one to push us forward.
records.en_auxiliary: Because that way, I can be the one to reign you in. You need to be the one to push us forward.
records.en: When things look dangerous, I will stop you. That will be my role.<CR>So you should keep moving forward, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 伶那さん……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...
records.en: Rena-san...

records.jp: 後ろに伶那さんがいると思うと……<CR>安心できる、かも
records.en_original: I think I feel better knowing that you'll have my back.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I feel better knowing that you'll have my back.
records.en: Knowing that you are behind me, Rena-san...<CR>I think I may feel safer.

records.jp: かもって何よ？　そこは言い切っていいでしょ
records.en_original: "Think"? Where's that decisiveness from before?
records.en_auxiliary: "Think"? Where's that decisiveness from before?
records.en: What do you mean, "may"? You can say that with certainty.

records.jp: ……ふふっ、なんかいつの間にか元気出たかも
records.en_original: Hehe. I feel a lot better now.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I feel a lot better now.
records.en: ...Hehe. Somehow, I feel better now.

records.jp: 何それ……。ま、元気が出たならいいけどさ
records.en_original: You really are a strange one... I'm glad you're feeling better.
records.en_auxiliary: You really are a strange one... I'm glad you're feeling better.
records.en: What is that supposed to mean...? Well, as long as you feel better.

records.jp: ……うん、知ってる
records.en_original: ...Yeah, I know.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah, I know.
records.en: ...Yeah, I know.

records.jp: うるさい、ばか……
records.en_original: No need to look so pleased about it.
records.en_auxiliary: No need to look so pleased about it.
records.en: Shut up, idiot...

records.jp: ……でも……だから
records.en_original: But that's exactly why—
records.en_auxiliary: But that's exactly why—
records.en: But that's exactly why—

records.jp: あなたみたいに、前に踏み出す人が必要で……
records.en_original: I need someone to take those first steps for me. Someone like you.
records.en_auxiliary: I need someone to take those first steps for me. Someone like you.
records.en: We need someone like you who can take a step forward...

records.jp: 私は、あなたを信じることにした
records.en_original: So I've decided to put my trust in you.
records.en_auxiliary: So I've decided to put my trust in you.
records.en: I have decided to trust you.

records.jp: ……そっか
records.en_original: You will?
records.en_auxiliary: You will?
records.en: ...I see.

records.jp: ……私は、あなたを信じることにした私のことも<CR>信じてる……信じたい
records.en_original: I want you to trust me too.
records.en_auxiliary: I want you to trust me too.
records.en: ...I also trust—or want to trust—the version of me who<CR>decided to trust you.

records.jp: だから、あなたもあなた自身のことを<CR>信じてもらわなきゃ……困る
records.en_original: But first you have to trust yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: But first you have to trust yourself.
records.en: That's why I need you to trust yourself too...<CR>or I'm going to be in trouble.

records.jp: ……もしかして、元気づけてくれてる？
records.en_original: Is this...your way of cheering me up?
records.en_auxiliary: Is this...your way of cheering me up?
records.en: Is this...your way of cheering me up?

records.jp: ……わざわざ聞くな
records.en_original: Don't ruin the moment.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't ruin the moment.
records.en: ...Do not ask me that.

records.jp: ご、ごめん……
records.en_original: S-sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: S-sorry...
records.en: S-sorry...

records.jp: ……ありがとう
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>それぞれの役割<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>Everybody's Roles<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>Everybody's Roles<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>Everybody's Roles<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
